evidence_quotes: Just as previously commented you MUST cream the shortening, margarine and sugar at least 10-12 minutes and do not leave out the flour and milk either.

benefit.description: Creaming the shortening, margarine, and sugar for the recommended time may help develop a smoother filling.

edits.replacement_text: Combine flour and milk in saucepan. Cook, stirring constantly, until thick. Cool completely. Cream 1 cup sugar, 1/2 cup margarine, and shortening for at least 10-12 minutes. Add cooled milk mixture, and beat well. Spread over cake. Refrigerate.

evidence_quotes: Once you spread it on the cake, refrigerate it for about an hour then spread the icing.

benefit.description: Refrigerating the filling for about an hour before icing may help it set.
